say:3:1320719002:1.text: It's smashed to bits... like a cookie someone sat on!
say:3:1320719002:1.source_cn: 被那怪物啄坏了，碎得像是一块摔烂的曲奇饼。
say:3:1320719002:1.male: It's smashed to bits... like a cookie someone sat on!
say:3:1320719002:1.female: It's smashed to bits... like a cookie someone sat on!

say:4:1320719003:1.text: This was a gift from Master Arden... Now, it's only good for firewood.
say:4:1320719003:1.source_cn: 这可是雅顿老爷子送我的礼物……这下子它只能当柴火了。
say:4:1320719003:1.male: This was a gift from Master Arden... Now, it's only good for firewood.

narration:9:1320719005:0.text: Lorsan takes the lute and strums it, but the melody turns out strange.
narration:9:1320719005:0.source_cn: 洛桑试着弹奏旋律，但是不知为什么，旋律变得非常奇怪
narration:9:1320719005:0.male: Lorsan takes the lute and strums it, but the melody turns out strange.
narration:9:1320719005:0.female: Lorsan takes the lute and strums it, but the melody turns out strange.

say:11:1320719006:1.text: The sound is a bit off...
say:11:1320719006:1.male: The sound is a bit off...
say:11:1320719006:1.female: The sound is a bit off...

say:12:1320719007:1.text: The lute was enchanted with ancient magic from Misarte's followers. It could resonate with nature when it played.
say:12:1320719007:1.source_cn: 琴上附有古老魔法，那种魔法只有弥萨忒的子民才能使用，演...
say:12:1320719007:1.male: The lute was enchanted with ancient magic from Misarte's followers. It could resonate with nature when it played.
say:12:1320719007:1.female: The lute was enchanted with ancient magic from Misarte's followers. It could resonate with nature when it played.

say:13:1320719008:1.text: Now the magic has dissipated, it can't play those beautiful melodies anymore.
say:13:1320719008:1.source_cn: 它被破坏的时候，那道特殊的魔法也消散了，所以没办法弹奏...
say:13:1320719008:1.male: Now the magic has dissipated, it can't play those beautiful melodies anymore.
say:13:1320719008:1.female: Now the magic has dissipated, it can't play those beautiful melodies anymore.

say:14:1320719009:1.text: Still, it's whole again, so thank you for that!
say:14:1320719009:1.source_cn: 不管怎么说，至少它现在看起来漂漂亮亮的！还是要谢谢你。
say:14:1320719009:1.male: Still, it's whole again, so thank you for that!
say:14:1320719009:1.female: Still, it's whole again, so thank you for that!

choice_prompt:15:1320719009.female: Still, it's whole again, so thank you for that!

say:16:1320719010:1.text: Come on, don't say that! Without you, I would've just used it as firewood!
say:16:1320719010:1.source_cn: 怎么会？要不是你及时把它恢复原状，它只能变成柴火了！
say:16:1320719010:1.male: Come on, don't say that! Without you, I would've just used it as firewood!
say:16:1320719010:1.female: Come on, don't say that! Without you, I would've just used it as firewood!

say:17:1320719012:1.text: Let's not dwell on it. I believe it'll find its own good fortune.

say:17:1320719012:1.male: Let's not dwell on it. I believe it'll find its own good fortune.
